summary: Since Ansible 2.10 inventory scripts live in their collections or in ansible-community/contrib-scripts; plugins are recommended instead.
questions: Where did the inventory scripts go in Ansible 2.10?
Where can I find old EC2 or OpenStack inventory scripts?

answer_card.title: Where inventory scripts went
answer_card.answer_md: Since Ansible 2.10 inventory scripts moved to their related collections, and many are in the `ansible-community/contrib-scripts` repository. Prefer inventory plugins instead.
